name: concept
leaves: docs/concept.md, docs/art.md and an art proof that passed 3 critics

steps.do: Research: 3 references (one award winner), what the category looks like, what to avoid
Art route A, code first: a real piece of the hero art made in code (three.js/R3F shaders, canvas, SVG, GSAP)
Art route B: supplied or generated stills used as materials on coded geometry (never flat layers moved by masks)
2-3 concepts, one signature idea each, picked from the art that exists
3 blind critics on the art proof, at once
Origin and licence of every asset
Council only if two concepts stay close and the choice is costly
